# Nails Spa & Threading

> Nail salon & eyebrow threading based in Georgetown, Texas. Manicures, deluxe spa pedicures, gel, acrylic, SNS dip and eyebrow threading on Williams Drive. Owned and worked by Christine and Richard: spotless, friendly, and walk-ins welcome.

- Phone: (512) 869-2256
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Leander, Liberty Hill, Jarrell, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.2 from 62 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-spa-and-threading/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-spa-and-threading/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & pedicures: Spa manicures and deluxe spa pedicures in clean, comfy chairs, plus a kid’s spa pedicure with its own little chairs.
- Gel, acrylic & dip: Solar and color gel, acrylic and fills, SNS dipping powder and pink & white, finished with air brush or a design if you like.
- Threading & waxing: Christine’s eyebrow threading on a reclined table, plus waxing. Easy to add on while you’re in for nails.

## About
Nails Spa & Threading is a family-run salon in the strip center at 3010 Williams Dr in Georgetown. Christine and Richard own it and work it: Richard does nails (regulars swear by his pink & whites), and Christine does pedicures and the eyebrow threading. Some clients have followed them for more than a decade, from their first location to this one. Reviewers keep coming back to the same things: the salon is spotless, the owners are hardworking and genuine, and they do their best to fit walk-ins in. Chair remotes stay wrapped in plastic, pedicure basins are emptied and sanitized right after each client, and disposable liners and personal care boxes are there on request.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call (512) 869-2256 if you’re not sure.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk in any time we’re open and we’ll do our best to fit you in. If your schedule is tight, call ahead for an appointment.
- Q: Who does the eyebrow threading?
  A: Christine. Threading is done on a reclined table, on its own or added to a nail visit.
- Q: Do you do kids’ pedicures?
  A: Yes. We have a kid’s spa pedicure with two little chairs of its own, so bring them along with you.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: We take credit cards and Apple Pay. Gift certificates are available too, just ask at the front desk.
- Q: Where are you and where do I park?
  A: 3010 Williams Dr #109, Georgetown, TX 78628, in the strip center with Scrubs and Exacta BTS. There’s parking right in front of our door, and the salon is wheelchair accessible.
